summary: Attached the batch-ordering knowledge entry to the vote-durability account and noted its one early-release path. In processSteps the free-order messages plus processReadyToRead, processDroppedEntries and processDroppedReadIndexes run before logdb.SaveRaftState, while the remaining messages including vote responses are released by processRaftUpdate after that save. The readiness signals released early report an index the node has already committed, so they carry no election state and do not weaken the argument that a granted vote is persisted before its response is sent. Added the knowledge use; the conclusion, defect claim and receipts are unchanged. Validation reports valid, no_change false, execution_requested false, with an interpretation append whose only changed field is knowledge. No execution was run.
